{{small|(CEO & Managing Director)}} | industry = [[Aerospace]] and [[Defense (military)|Defense]] | revenue = | operating_income = | net_income = | assets = [[United States dollar|US$]]5 [[1,000,000,000|billion]] (''2013'') | equity = | products = [[Cruise missile]]s | website = [https://www.brahmos.com brahmos.com] }} '''BrahMos Aerospace''' is an Indo-Russian [[multinational corporation|multinational]] [[Aerospace manufacturer|aerospace]] and [[Arms industry|defense]] corporation, with core manufacturing concentrations in [[cruise missile]]s. Headquartered in [[New Delhi]], [[India]], it was founded as a [[joint venture]] between the India's [[DRDO|Defence Research and Development Organisation]] and [[NPO Mashinostroyeniya]] of Russia. Company's name is a [[portmanteau]] formed from the names of two rivers, the [[Brahmaputra River|Brahmaputra]] of India and the [[Moskva (river)|Moskva]] of Russia. The company currently manufactures the '''[[BrahMos]]''' missile with a range of 800 km and traveling at speeds of [[Mach (speed)|Mach]] 2.8.{{Cite web |last=Menon |first=Adithya Krishna |date=2 land in Nettukaltheri, near [[Neyyar Dam]]. This move is important for [[Thiruvananthapuram International Airport]]'s runway expansion that is planned. Preliminary round of discussion was completed and the proposal was forwarded by [[Chief minister of Kerala|Chief Minister]] [[Pinarayi Vijayan]]. However, the [[Ministry of Defence (India)|Ministry of Defence]] has not cleared the move yet.{{Cite news |date=2024-10-29 |title=Land proposed in Nettukaltheri to relocate BrahMos Aerospace |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/thiruvananthapuram/nettukaltheri-land-proposed-for-relocating-brahmos-aerospace-to-facilitate-thiruvananthapuram-airport-expansion/articleshow/114743583.cms |access-date=2024-11-01 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} Reports in 2025 also suggested that BATL could be transferred to the direct control of DRDO.{{Cite web |date=2025-07-02 |title='BrahMos Aerospace Thiruvananthapuram will be brought under DRDO,' clarifies Rajeev Chandrasekhar - BusinessToday |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/india/story/brahmos-aerospace-thiruvananthapuram-will-be-brought-under-drdo-clarifies-rajeev-chandrasekhar-482744-2025-07-02 |access-date=2025-07-05 |website=Business Today |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2025-07-02 |title=BrahMos unit in Thiruvananthapuram will be brought directly under DRDO: Rajeev Chandrasekhar |url=https://english.mathrubhumi.com/news/india/brahmos-unit-in-thiruvananthapuram-will-be-brought-directly-under-drdo-rajeev-chandrasekhar-akstor0e |access-date=2025-07-05 |website=@mathrubhumi |language=en}} * '''[[Lucknow]], [[Uttar Pradesh]]''' ''':''' BrahMos Aerospace Integration and Testing Facility in Lucknow is the production facility for the existing BrahMos variants as well as the future [[BrahMos#BrahMos-NG|BrahMos-NG]].{{Cite web |title=100 To 150 Missiles Every Year: Inside India's New BrahMos Production Unit |url=https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/india-pakistan-operation-sindoor-100-to-150-missiles-every-year-inside-indias-new-brahmos-production-unit-8386155 |access-date=2025-05-12 |website=www.ndtv.com |language=en}} The foundation stone for the project was laid in December 2021 as a part of the [[Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridor]].{{cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/rajnath-singh-inaugurates-brahmos-missile-manufacturing-unit-in-lucknow-121122600508_1.html|title=Rajnath Singh inaugurates Brahmos missile manufacturing unit in Lucknow|date=27 December 2021|website=Business Standard|access-date=14 January 2022}} The facility has been developed on a {{Convert|200|acre|km2|abbr=on}} land under a project worth ₹300 crore (US$35 million). The facility was inaugurated on 11 May 2025 by [[Minister of Defence (India)|Defence Minister]], [[Rajnath Singh]]. Initially, the facility will have an annual production rate of 80-100 units from 2026 onwards,{{Cite news |date=2024-05-10 |title=BrahMos to be produced in Lucknow by 2026: Rajnath Singh |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/lucknow/brahmos-to-be-produced-in-lucknow-by-2026-rajnath/articleshow/109993217.cms |access-date=2024-11-01 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} which will later be enhanced to 100-150 units of BrahMos-NG. It also includes a Titanium and Super Alloys Materials Plant (officially, the Strategic Materials Technology Complex) and Defence Testing Infrastructure System (DTIS). ** The first consignment of BrahMos missiles from the facility was delivered to the [[Indian Army]]{{Cite news |date=2026-04-13 |title=First batch of BrahMos made in Lucknow delivered to Army; national security is collective duty of every citizen, not just forces: Rajnath |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/first-batch-of-brahmos-made-in-lucknow-delivered-to-army-rajnath/articleshow/130216848.cms |access-date=2026-04-13 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} on 18 October 2025. The Booster Building was also inaugurated by the Defence Minister and the [[Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh|Chief Minister]], [[Yogi Adityanath]]. The booster docking process was also demonstrated. They also reviewed presentations at the Airframe and Avionics, Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI), and Warhead Buildings, in addition to inspecting the BrahMos simulator equipment.{{Cite press release |title=Aatmanirbhar Bharat: Raksha Mantri and UP Chief Minister flag-off first batch of BrahMos missiles manufactured at BrahMos Integration & Testing Facility Centre under UP Defence Corridor in Lucknow |date=2025-10-18 |publisher=Press Information Bureau |url=https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2180675 |access-date=2025-10-19}}{{Cite web |last=Sharma |first=Shivani |date=2025-10-17 |title=Lucknow to roll out first batch of BrahMos missiles tomorrow |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/lucknow-first-batch-of-brahmos-missiles-roll-out-tomorrow-2804796-2025-10-17 |access-date=2025-10-18 |website=India Today |language=en}} ==Aim and objective== To fulfil the aim which was to design, develop, manufacture and market the world's fastest supersonic cruise missile system.{{cite news|url=https://www.brahmos.com/|title=BrahMos Aerospace|website=BrahMos Aerospace|access-date=14 January 2022|archive-date=12 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230212092119/https://www.brahmos.com/|url-status=dead}} ==Organisation and leadership== {{col-begin}} {{col-2}} {| class="sortable wikitable" ! BrahMos Aerospace is an Indo-Russian multinational aerospace and defense corporation, with core manufacturing concentrations in cruise missiles. Headquartered in New Delhi, India, it was founded as a joint venture between the India's Defence Research and Development Organisation and NPO Mashinostroyeniya of Russia. Company's name is a portmanteau formed from the names of two rivers, the Brahmaputra of India and the Moskva of Russia. The company currently manufactures the BrahMos missile with a range of 800 km and traveling at speeds of Mach 2.8. It is also reportedly developing BrahMos-II, a hypersonic cruise missile.
India is a member of the MTCR, India and Russia are now planning to jointly develop a new generation of Brahmos missiles with 600 km-plus range and an ability to hit protected targets with pinpoint accuracy.
